thread:
marta: heads up — onboarding sampleapp produced duplicate webhook deliveries after a 429 during token rotation. repro: generate -> 429 -> sdk refresh -> immediate retry -> two webhook posts.
leo: can you paste the minimal logs? want to confirm client retried immediately.
marta: log snippet: `OUT POST /v1/generate id=reqX` -> `IN 429 {"error":"rate_limited"}` -> sdk: `auth.refresh()` -> `OUT POST /v1/generate id=reqX` -> `IN 200 {"id":"g_100"}`. consumer saw g_100 and g_101 ~130ms apart.
sre-jess: so server accepted both. sampleapp wasn't setting Idempotency-Key for generate calls?
marta: no, we only set it for payments flows.
leo: short-term: patch sampleapp to add `Idempotency-Key: <user>_<body-hash>` for user-visible generates. medium-term SDK changes: add small post-refresh retry jitter (default 120± 60ms), emit `sdk.retry.post_refresh` telemetry with hashed_body, and opt-in transient dedupe (TTL 2s) behind `enableTransientDedupe=false`.
sre-jess: streaming/resume flows must be exempted. leader-lock per-process could also help but keep opt-in.
ci-bot: created issue #9302: "sdk: mitigate duplicate accepts after auth refresh — jitter, telemetry, opt-in transient dedupe"
marta: I'll open sampleapp PR with repro harness and link #9302. thanks all :thumbsup:
